This is the worst class I have ever taken at SFU. Easy content but not a GPA booster because the quizzes are very subjective. I do not recommend.

One of the least enjoyable classes I have taken at SFU. It has very dry content, and if you have ever taken a film or music class with the SCA it is likely that you know most of the terms already. The content is very elementary, but then the very subjective quizzes can easily lower your mark. Extremely uninteresting, especially as an online class.

Not enjoyable and I cannot type words against the guideline here but I'm very frustrated with this class, quizzes are so subjective and difficult. Only four quiz worth 40% and if you messed up one of these really diffuse quiz goodbye to your grade.

Dr. Eigenfeldt is super nice, he was always accessible and took the time to explain things for this online course. The course is tough, you need an above and beyond understanding to get an A on assignments, even with great feedback, it's hard to improve, it was an interesting course but if you want an easy A upper div elective, this isn't the one!

Very boring and redundant assignments.The 1st one was fine but then the 2nd and 3rd assignments come around and they are the exact same thing and getting through them becomes so dreadful. I am honestly so disappointed by this course not only did I not learn anything but it is more of a gpa tanker than a booster. Please take another elective instead
